control._why: Duress, Disdainful Stroke and Annul fight our spells; a 2nd Wan Shi Tong adds card draw. Cuts cheap creature removal that has few targets.

midrange._why: More creature removal (edict also exiles the graveyard) instead of soft counters.

aggro._why: More cheap removal (Requiting Hex, Strategic Betrayal) and Vren as a sturdy blocker. Cuts counterspells. (added 2026-11-23 for the meta round robin)

graveyard._why: Added 2026-11-26: their best against graveyard-based aggro decks (graveyard hate, cards that stop enter triggers, cheap removal, sweepers). Strategic Betrayal exiles the whole graveyard, Vren exiles our dying creatures, Day of Black Sun sweeps cheap creatures.
